title: 040 amendment: round the transition stand-in's inputs (9 decimals), refit, re-test tr_scale
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test. Committed before any rounded stand-in is fit.
amends: preregistration_transition.json stand_in (inputs) and the tr_scale arms' evidence (verdicts_transition.json, verdicts_trscale_ext.json)
why: the in-strategy stand-in (live path) recomputes inputs from the bot's own series start; base:fast_diff (fastd - fastk, TA-Lib running sums) is ~1e-14 residue on candles where it is 0, its value depends on the series start, and the stand-in splits inside it: NNMT_LR_RI on the defaults made tr_scale_mt's trades but 12/6854 transition flags differed (44.786 vs 44.912). Rounding every input to 9 decimals at fit and scoring removes the residue.

change.fit: research.nnmt.transition fit --fold fNN --decimals 9 --root transition_r9 (seed 1); --bootstrap --random-state 1 --root transition_r9_bs1 (seed 2, the bootstrap draw of preregistration_transition_seed.json); every other stand-in setting as preregistration_transition.json; cells unchanged (up_pair_96, down_pair_672); thresholds = each fit's tail p80

cs_aro_tr_r9.use: cs_aro + tr_scale on the rounded stand-in (in-strategy)

tr_scale_mt_r9.use: NNMT_LR_RI on the NNMT defaults (24 h grace, tr_scale) with the rounded stand-in

tr_scale_gbr_r9.use: cs_gbr + tr_scale on the rounded stand-in

instrument.start_date_parity: on every fold and both families (NNNC cs_aro fold frame, NNMT NNMT_LR_RI fold frame), the in-strategy probabilities over the backtest range equal the fit's own predictions (pred.parquet, full-history series) on every test row: max |diff| 0 and no fire mismatch
instrument.live_buffer: research.nnmt.live_check on the rounded f14 stand-in: fire agreement 1.0
instrument.audit: each arm's trades = its comparator's (count and exit reasons) on every fold; a capital-limited difference is reported

seeds: every arm is also run on the bootstrap fit (<arm>_bs1, preregistration_transition_round_seed.json), which decides
adoption: if all three arms PASS both seeds and the instrument holds, the rounded stand-in (transition_r9) replaces the unrounded one in the defaults (NNNC_CS_ARO_TR, NNMTStrategy, live_fold); otherwise the result is reported and the user decides
seen_before: unrounded: tr_scale PASS both seeds on cs_aro (65.35/66.97), NNMT (44.91/49.47), GBR (61.89/63.70)
in-strategy unrounded: NNNC exact; NNMT 12/6854 flags differ
no rounded stand-in has been fit before this commit
